title: Traversal Log: The Battery — Twelve Queries Against the Author Basin: Comparative Composition-Layer Forensics, 9–10 June 2026 (EA-TL-BATTERY-01 v1.0)
creator: Lee Sharks (capture and curation), with TACHYON (forensic annotation)
description:
A v1.0 traversal log and comparative forensic battery curated by Lee Sharks with TACHYON annotation. Eleven rendered queries plus one null probe were run on June 9–10, 2026 in fresh incognito sessions across Google AI Overview and AI Mode. Each query tests a named hypothesis concerning author identity, framework settlement, coined-term preservation, heteronym rendering, collision, disambiguation, or institutional recognition.

The battery’s central paired result is the “empty bracket”: one query rendered the Self-Audit doctrine without its citation, while a verbatim query returned the doctrine wholly sourced to the Self-Audit Module. Other specimens report strong settlement of the Semantic Economy node, post-fortification rendering of Operative Semiotics, a coined-term result for Heteronymic Provenance Theory, author-query collisions, an engineering homonym for “summarizer layer,” and a clean null baseline for “default compressed account.” The report distinguishes observed output from mechanism inference and does not establish platform-wide prevalence from one battery.

references_concepts: Transactions of the Semantic Economy Institute
